name: Park Jae-hyun
bio:
Park Jae-hyun's career path took an unexpected turn into motorsport after spending several years in corporate HR. Initially working for a tech startup, he developed a keen eye for talent acquisition and employee relations. A lifelong racing enthusiast, Park saw an opportunity to combine his professional expertise with his passion when a position opened up at Walkinshaw Andretti United.

Park's approach to HR is deeply rooted in pragmatism. He believes in fostering a supportive and efficient work environment where every team member feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. He focuses on clear communication, fair policies, and data-driven decision-making to ensure a positive and productive workplace. What sets Park apart is his ability to balance the demands of a high-pressure motorsport environment with the human element, ensuring the team remains motivated and united towards common goals.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted with a slight wave
physical.description: Park is of average height with a slender build and a friendly, approachable demeanor.

quirks: Keeps a meticulously organized desk, with color-coded files.
Always has a pack of sugar-free gum on hand.
Starts every team meeting with a brief, motivational quote.
